title: EPT Benchmark: Evaluation of Persian Trustworthiness in Large Language Models
findings: The study found significant disparities in model performance regarding alignment with Persian-Islamic values. Claude 3.7 Sonnet demonstrated the highest and most consistent performance, while Qwen 3 performed the weakest. Safety was the most challenging dimension for most models, indicating a critical gap in aligning LLMs with the cultural and ethical norms of the Persian-Islamic context.
